notes: The programme's own page is the Management BSc page; the task names "International Economics and Management" (class L-18). The pages supplied do not contain a dedicated page for a programme called "International Economics and Management"; the closest content is the Management BSc page (class L-18). Second selection round (Early Session, 2–29 September 2026) also exists for international applicants. Tuition left out: the Fees page gives an institution-wide figure of € 17,700 per year for first-year BSc/Law students, and the income-based ISU/Bocconi4Access ISEE thresholds (ISEE/ISEEU parificato no higher than € 26.887,93) are exemption limits, not a fee; no accepted quote states a fee specifically for a non-EU applicant with household abroad (Morocco) for this programme's group, and no quote names Morocco in a country-group fee list. Application channel left out: the pages name the Apply2B portal, not Universitaly, and do not state a Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU applicants (an immigration/student visa page is mentioned but not supplied).
